subject: ddl: re-structure ddl executor part 2 (#55140)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent, scoped to `pkg/ddl` DDL/add-index/infoschema/metadata/state-machine behavior. The change is predominantly mechanical refactoring: code is split/moved out of `executor.go`/`column.go`/`table.go` into new files (`job_submitter.go`, `create_table.go`, `add_column.go`, `modify_column.go`) plus moved helpers into `partition.go`, `placement_policy.go`, `resource_group.go`, and `index.go`, with Bazel srcs updated. Spot-checked high-risk paths (job submission/wait + notify channel lifecycle, add-index queueing/dependency, create-table and add/modify-column job state transitions, partition/placement/resource-group validation helpers) and found no plausible Blocker/High correctness, consistency, compatibility, concurrency, or metadata/state-machine regressions attributable to this commit; behavior appears unchanged aside from relocation and minor naming/packaging adjustments (e.g., dead table lock cleanup helper).
